note: Companion to ref-shaped-fallthrough for the J36 bare-number flip (QR-4/P5.3): bare-number shapes with no resolving book and no unique in-policy suggestion fall through to discovery instead of dead-ending as invalid-reference. This fixture pins the two shapes ref-shaped-fallthrough does not cover.

"3 16" — an all-numeric pair with no book text at all — is invalid-reference today; after the flip it must reach discovery and must NEVER be captured as a resolved reference (there is no book to resolve; a machine-guessed book here would be the exact harm J35 forbids).

"grateful for 2024" — a felt-need query ending in a year — is invalid-reference today because the locator regex captures the digit tail (bookText "grateful for 2", locator "024"). It is precisely the memory-query class the J36 flip rescues: no resolving book, no in-policy suggestion, bare-number shape -> discovery.
Stays PENDING until QR-4's deciding commit, exactly as ref-shaped-fallthrough's note prescribes: the fallthrough policy is decided and ratified there (J36), not here.
